# Spacer and shaft-collar references

Use the same reference in the clips, the parts list and the print catalogue. Quantities are for one rover.

SP01–SP08 match the existing dot IDs. SP09–SP12 are guide references only; these pieces have no dot marking. LK codes identify purchased shaft collars (also called lock rings), not printed parts.

| Ref | Part | Length | Bore | Outside diameter | Qty | Mark |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| SP01 | Road wheel / inner | 7.5 mm | 5.3 mm | 7.6 mm | 6 | 1 dots |
| SP02 | Road wheel / outer | 5.5 mm | 5.3 mm | 7.6 mm | 6 | 2 dots |
| SP03 | Drive / motor side | 7.6 mm | 6.4 mm | 9 mm | 2 | 3 dots |
| SP04 | Drive / outer | 12.6 mm | 6.4 mm | 9 mm | 2 | 4 dots |
| SP05 | Idler / inner | 15.4 mm | 8.4 mm | 12 mm | 2 | 5 dots |
| SP06 | Idler / outer | 13.4 mm | 8.4 mm | 12 mm | 2 | 6 dots |
| SP07 | Idler / inner retainer | 6.3 mm | 8.4 mm | 12 mm | 2 | 7 dots |
| SP08 | Idler / outer retainer | 6 mm | 8.4 mm | 12 mm | 2 | 8 dots |
| SP09 | Road wheel / centre | 18 mm | 5.3 mm | 7.6 mm | 6 | No dots |
| SP10 | Idler / centre | 3.8 mm | 8.4 mm | 12 mm | 2 | No dots |
| SP11 | Drive / bearing to collar | 3.5 mm | 6.4 mm | 9 mm | 2 | No dots |
| SP12 | Track frame / cross-member | 41 mm | 4.4 mm | 14 mm | 4 | No dots |
| LK05 | Shaft collar / lock ring | 5 mm | 5 mm | 10 mm | 12 | Buy |
| LK06 | Shaft collar / lock ring | 5 mm | 6 mm | 11 mm | 2 | Buy |
| LK08 | Shaft collar / lock ring | 8 mm | 8 mm | 16 mm | 4 | Buy |

Collar sizes are taken from the CAD envelopes. LK codes identify the dimensions in the table; they are not manufacturer part numbers.
